dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' structures include a central closed elliptical ring with a thin light-grey perimeter, a vertically-aligned figure-eight structure consisting of two joined annuli directly below the center, and a larger, irregular, wavy-edged ring to the right. The contrast gradient transitions sharply from the black exterior pelage to a light-grey interior-facing edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of high-intensity pixels in a large, amorphous yellowish-tan cluster located at the lower-left boundary. A lower density of small, solid, high-intensity white/grey pixel clusters is scattered across the upper-mid dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangle is formed by connecting the centroids of the primary central elliptical ring, the lower figure-eight structure, and the large wavy ring to the right. A horizontal spatial relationship exists between the anterior yellowish-tan blob and the central elliptical ring.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, multi-lobed yellowish-tan patch at the far left edge of the frame that differs significantly in chromatic intensity and hue from the white/grey dorsal ring structures.
